info.name: Foodwell Security and Full API
info.description: Security-first test of the whole Foodwell API (48 operations). Folders: 0 sign-in; 1 authentication, sessions and login throttling; 2 no login on every protected route (401); 3 wrong role (403) with state checks; 4 object-level access between customers; 5 tampering with role/owner/actor/price fields; 6 staff and admin powers and deactivation; 7 injection, bounds and leakage; 8 CORS; 9 the normal customer and staff journey. Run with `composer test:security`, which gives it a fresh disposable database. To send it by hand, reset a disposable database first (`composer db:setup`) and set baseUrl; the login limit is 30 attempts per IP per 15 minutes, so wait 15 minutes between two manual runs.

item.name: 0. Setup: sign in the four seed accounts
item.description: Seeded accounts: 7 Alex and 8 Sam (customers), 9 staff, 10 admin.

exec: pm.test("Returns a Bearer token and an expiry", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.tokenType).to.eql("Bearer"); pm.expect(b.accessToken).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/); pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("No secret or internal detail in the body", () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ["password", "Hash", "SQLSTATE", "Stack trace", "PDOException", "token_hash", "/src/"].forEach(w => pm.expect(t, w).to.not.include(w)); });
pm.test("Protected response is not cached (Cache-Control: no-store)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Cache-Control") || "").to.include("no-store"));
